name: frontend-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the frontend stack category in one install — UI/UX stacks, React, React Native, Vue 3, Next.js, Nuxt, Vite, Inertia, Livewire, the generalist web worker, accessibility auditing, and skill auto-routing (skill-router). The creative-build studio — craft-layer, design-preview, shadcn-studio, registry-source, threejs — moved to craft-suite, so ordinary frontend app work does not pay the studio's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /frontend-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
